## Runner tests

POST to this webhook with `{}` to run the 25 default cases of `test/cases.json` against the nested runners of *Query Sage X3 - generic agent and MCP server*, or with `{ "cases": [...] }` for your own. A case is `{ name, target: "sql" | "object", input: {...}, expect: { ok, error, count, rows, min_rows, column0, truncated, max_rows, params_used, all_rows, some_row } }`. The answer is `{ passed, failed, results: [...] }`. The default cases are read-only against Sage X3.
